args.title: Bellwether Office: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
• Newsletter: Bellwether Office's latest issue covers "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a blog article and a companion piece accessible via free email registration.
• Article: Autonomous carts drove an 18% rise in pick rates in 2026, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
